description: Get a short-lived signed URL to download (HTTP GET) a command artifact from a sandbox by its artifact id (e.g. a command's stdout/stderr artifact). Note: the API supports download-by-artifact-id only, not download-by-path.

artifact_id.description: Artifact id to download (e.g. a command's stdout/stderr artifact).

session_id.description: Sandbox session id (UUID), from tenki_create_sandbox or tenki_list_sandboxes.

name: tenki_get_download_url
